owner_question: Which day or hour did the bill pattern change?
safe_action: Mark the first abnormal billing period before touching resources.

owner_question: Who can explain the workload, data, user traffic, or deployment?
safe_action: Assign one business owner and one technical owner for review.

owner_question: Is the increase from compute, storage, data transfer, support, licensing, or AI tokens?
safe_action: Split the bill by service category before proposing changes.

owner_question: Is the spend linked to a launch, customer demand, backup, audit, experiment, or forgotten resource?
safe_action: Tag each large item as keep, pause, resize, investigate, or retire.

owner_question: Could a cost change affect uptime, security logging, backup retention, or customer experience?
safe_action: Route risky changes to approval; start with reports and alerts.

owner_question: Will the team see whether the action helped or created side effects?
safe_action: Record before state, action, owner, timestamp, and follow-up review date.
